name: hero_welcome
prompt: A small floating rounded grassy island (soft green, gently rounded edges, no soil cross-section detail) holding a cozy friendly scene: a smiling cream-and-orange cat sitting on the left, a big shiny red apple with a green leaf in the middle-front, a small rounded orange toy car on the right, two chunky toy blocks (one turquoise with a star shape, one yellow with a circle shape) and a tiny blue flower. Two soft white clouds and a gentle pale-yellow sun float above. Transparent background around the island. Wide composition, everything visible.
